name: HOTKEY_EQUIP_UPGRADE_TIER_V1
owner_decision: WU26 native-client mechanics batch package 2 (client PR #3098); parity rule: Crystal 201189f8 and current Tibia
owner: Game character equipment owner (capability 180 carried hotkey selection)
offer_gate: Gated by BUNDLE_WORLD_OFFERED_CAPABILITIES. Bundle World only, with HOTKEY_EQUIP_V1 and HOTKEY_EQUIP_CARRIED_V1. Command 348 appends one byte upgrade_tier 0..=10 after the four definition bytes; the equipment owner matches definition and stored game_item_tiers tier (no row is tier 0) in the same fenced transaction and refuses when no such copy is worn or carried. Without selection the payload stays four bytes and a fifth byte is invalid.
